scope: Exploratory P1 audit of selection/evaluation coupling using fixed Study-B candidate pools

inputs.role: Previously verified organic size and MCS descriptors; QED, SA, validity and parent Tanimoto independently recomputed this run

missing_positions: Six unretained positions in one bounded technical failure remain in planned denominators with zero validity/utility; not declared model proposals.
random_primary: Analytical expectation of uniform sampling among distinct eligible canonical structures within each run; no Monte Carlo error and no seed selection.
random_sensitivity: uniform over eligible proposal positions, allowing duplicate structures
one fixed per-slot PCG64 draw, base seed42 hashed with slot_id
dedup: Last eligible occurrence per canonical retained for QED/SA/canonical selection; first-eligible remains first chronological eligible proposal before dedup.
budget: Chronological prefixes of 1..6 archived candidate positions; three from round1 then three from feedback-informed round2.
budget_limit: Saved-candidate inspection sensitivity, not measured API/time savings or generation under independently reduced budgets; all three round1 proposals entered round2 feedback.
yield_definition: Per-run accepted QED, zero for no delivery; random expected yield integrates the uniform selector exactly.
aggregation: Policy metrics average five planned runs within each target, then 25 equally weighted targets. Conditional candidate QED averages valid/eligible proposal positions within target, then across 25 targets.
proposal_QED_yield: Sum of QED over valid proposals / 30 nominal proposal positions per target; invalid and missing positions contribute zero.
new_tests: Six exploratory contrasts: M-T,G-T,G-M under random expected final yield and under valid-proposal QED yield, Holm correction across all six.
selection_effects: Best-minus-first and best-minus-random yield contrasts: descriptive paired bootstrap95CI, no significance test of mechanically nonnegative best-minus-mean.
statistics: Same released seed42 bootstrap10000 and signflip100000; confidence intervals unadjusted; unit25 targets.
chemical_descriptors: Recompute valid SMILES, QED, standard SA, MW, heavy atoms, fragments, RingCount and original parent Morgan Tanimoto; validate eligibility excluding seed/references.
other_metrics: Report SA, structural similarity and organic size changes for alternative selections; use previously computed MCS lower/upper flags without new searches.
